title: A.D. White — Cross Creek and the Dinsmore family
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — oral history
date_source: The cassette label reads 10.31.71 — recorded in the archive JSON's `date_basis`; the original capture filename it also records, `10.31.71 Alvin Dinsmore White  History of Cross Creek and Dinsmore family.m4a`, carries the same string. 31 October 1971 was a Sunday, the day this class met. The tape corroborates it: Ann Connor announced on the 17 October 1971 class tape that "on the 31st of this month, Mr. Alvin Dinsmore White is going to come back", and at the head of this tape she introduces him. Nothing on the tape contradicts the label. 2026-10-18 is the digitisation date, not the recording date.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: One cassette side, captured as ALAC 48 kHz stereo 16-bit, 1,862.997 s, 60,978,057 bytes, unchanged as received (md5 674b2c72569f0c908c729d9101a7729a). The source folder also holds `second recording.m4a`, a shorter second capture of the same lecture (1,858.304 s); it was not transcribed and is not filed as a side. The master carries no processing; a +10.2 dB loudnorm working copy was made on disk for the ASR pass only.

speakers.label: WHITE
speakers.name: Alvin Dinsmore White
speakers.note: Of Hickory, Pennsylvania (1894–1992); author of the Cross Creek church history, and a great-great-great-grandson of James Dinsmore, whose life he narrates here. Named on the tape by Ann Connor at 5:41.

speakers.label: ANN
speakers.name: Ann Connor
speakers.note: Introducer, not an interviewer: she presents the speaker and his book to the class library from 0:00 to about 6:35, then hands over and does not question him. Named by White at 6:40 ("Thank you, Mrs. Conner").
